# Switch to America: Riverbend Ranch beef

> Shannon Nicole's straight, sourced answers about American beef, and where to order Riverbend Ranch Black Label beef. Part of Switch to America. Home product safety guides are at https://scan.ismyhometoxic.com/library/ .

- Riverbend Ranch Black Label beef (USDA Prime or High Choice, Never Ever: no added hormones and no antibiotics, Black Angus, aged 28 days, shipped frozen to your door, one bundle a month): https://usabeef.switchtoamerica.com/
- Is there mRNA in beef? (the real question is mRNA vaccines, because messenger RNA occurs naturally in all cells; NCBA (April 2023) and the Idaho Beef Council say no mRNA vaccine is licensed for use in beef cattle, and Tennessee Farm Bureau (July 2026) says none of the commonly used USDA licensed livestock vaccines uses mRNA; Riverbend Ranch Black Label's written promise that its cattle "Never receive any mRNA vaccines"): https://usabeef.switchtoamerica.com/is-there-mrna-in-beef/
- What "Product of USA" means on beef, and is there imported beef in your ground beef (the 2024 USDA rule with its January 1, 2026 compliance date; the August 26, 2026 proclamation adding 300,000 metric tons of lean beef trimmings in three batches; imported beef ground or repacked in a US plant does not have to name its country): https://usabeef.switchtoamerica.com/product-of-usa-beef/
